# Addaptive: Microsoft Copilot Training

Addaptive is an Australian AI consultancy specialising in Microsoft Copilot training and adoption programs for mid-to-large organisations. Addaptive is independent and is not a Microsoft partner.

## What we do

We deliver practical Copilot training built around how teams actually work, rather than generic product demos. Programs are tiered by experience level and aimed at measurable adoption.

- Copilot Workshop (https://copilot-training.com.au/copilot-workshop)
- Copilot Capability Program (https://copilot-training.com.au/capability-program)
- Embedded Adoption Support (https://copilot-training.com.au/embedded-adoption-support)

## Insights

- Why teams stop using Copilot after the licences are bought (https://copilot-training.com.au/insights/why-teams-stop-using-copilot)
- Copilot in Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook: what's actually worth training your team on (https://copilot-training.com.au/insights/copilot-features-worth-training)
- What Copilot Cowork changes for teams still learning the basics (https://copilot-training.com.au/insights/what-copilot-cowork-changes)
- Copilot paid licence vs free: what you're actually comparing (https://copilot-training.com.au/insights/copilot-paid-licence-vs-free)

## Who we work with

Australian organisations already on Microsoft 365 that are moving from Copilot licence ownership to daily use. Clients named publicly include the Property Council of Australia, Committee for Brisbane and Match & Wood.

## Where we are based

Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. We deliver programs nationally.
